 Kylie Kelce slams fans for invasive questions about her bedroom habits with husband Jason: ‘What the actual f–k?’ 
 By 
 Tamantha Ryan 
 Published 
 Nov. 19, 2026, 3:07 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Not gonna disclose.
 Kylie Kelce slammed a fan who asked about how she and “muscular” Jason Kelce spice it up in the bedroom.
 “Look at this question we legitimately got,” the mom of four said on her “Not Gonna Lie” podcast during a fan Q&A segment Thursday. 
 6

 6 
 The mom of four called out a fan who asked how she and the former NFL star “spice up the bedroom.” YouTube/nglwithkylie

 “This person asked, ‘Jason is strong, muscular with football and kids. How would do you’ — that’s not me, that was this person — ‘How would you spice up the bedroom?'” she read from the fan, who had a ton of grammatical errors.
 People in the background of Kylie’s podcast taping could be heard grunting, seemingly shocked at the fan’s invasive question. 
 “Yes, that audible groan is the appropriate response,” the podcast host said to her viewers. 
 6 
 She sarcastically suggested using cinnamon sticks in response to the intimate query. YouTube/nglwithkylie 
 “What the actual f–k? … This is the ridiculous s–t that ends up in our inbox,” she added.
 Kylie then sarcastically answered the fan, saying, “I suppose you could put some cinnamon sticks.” 
 “You didn’t want to know spices? Got it,” she quipped.

 Kylie, 34, and Jason, 39, met in late 2014 after matching on the dating app Tinder . Four years later, Kylie and the former NFL star tied the knot at The Logan Hotel in Philadelphia.
 The pair have since welcomed four daughters : Wyatt Elizabeth, Elliotte Ray, Bennett Llewellyn and Finnley Anne.
 In March, however, Kylie did open up about how intimacy with Jason has been since they welcomed their fourth child in March 2025.
 6 
 The couple (seen above with three of their kids) share four children. kykelce/Instagram 
 6 
 Kylie (seen above with Jason and their daughter) previously said intimacy with the former athlete was “not all fun and games” after she gave birth to baby No. 4. 
 “You can’t be out here, like, ‘That was great,’” she said on her podcast at the time of getting back in the saddle “the first couple of times.”
 “What? A human just exited that door.”
 Kylie said postpartum sex is “not all fun and games,” especially after giving birth vaginally.
